label: Chechil
note: Made from skimmed, soured milk, scalded and pulled into strands, braided and kept in brine; Armenia and Georgia

about.text: A brined string cheese of Armenia and Georgia, usually made from skimmed cow milk that is soured, set with rennet, scalded and pulled into thin strands that are braided into coils.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.label: sour, scald, braid
how.text: Curd is gathered, kneaded, stretched and tied into skeins; coils weigh 3–4 kg and are soaked in water before eating.

steps.note: Skimmed cow milk; sheep and goat mixes also used.
Soured by warming, or acid whey, sour milk or matsoni is added instead.
With rennet or pepsin, added at 45–50 T for cow milk or 100–110 T for sheep milk.
Until it flakes and sticks into a ribbon.
